span.p:
CONFIRMED blocking ⇒ fix at the offending LAYER,
then ONE remediation round, that finding only —
hard stop at 2 rounds; residuals are named and ship

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: REAL INCIDENT ⇒ NEW THEOREM (law 6): the lifecycle closes

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
a false finding on a real case is a defect in
spec, twin or shell — never patch the test

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: ③ confront it — independence is the point

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
BEAT 4 · ATTACK — against a DECLARED BUDGET
declare the surface set S first; cost = |S| × 4, known up front
mandatory pass: every lens × every surface, ONE round, parallel
(a) spec adequacy (b) twin fidelity
(c) can the shell lie? (d) integration
findings proved by execution
stop on COVERAGE, not on convergence

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SHIP
verify where it RUNS
extract + execute payload
rollback = config revert

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OPERATE
conformance ledger nightly
liveness line every run
independent watchdog

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: ② meet the world — the only impure layer

span.p:
BEAT 3.5 · SHELL
I/O, logs, devices, orders
observed-sample semantics
provenance per observable

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
falsifiability tiering
monitored · attempt-adjacent
inert-until-X · internal-only
badge must match detector

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
BEAT 3.75 · VALIDATE
replay real history +
the motivating incident
boring days stay quiet

span.p: ① build the contract — offline, pure, no environment

span.p:
BEAT 1 · PROVE
kernel-checked spec of record
fail direction per property
completeness gate: zero holes

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Contract.lean
Conforming predicate
witnesses · consequences
incidents as theorems

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
BEAT 2 · TWIN
pure implementation,
clause for clause
transcription or extraction

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
twin.py
no I/O · no clocks
numeric domain ⊇ model's

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BEAT 3 · BRIDGE
conformance suite,
one gate, judged by exit code

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
bridge/
witnesses · theorem mirrors
mutations · brute force
samples, ≠ refinement proof

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
UPSTREAM — outside FCDD
hazard analysis (FMEA / STPA)
yields properties P1..Pn

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CROSS-CUTTING LAWS (apply to every beat)
1 degraded input ⇒ conservative verdict · 2 local proofs die at stateful seams
3 the badge must match the detector · 4 verify claims where they run
5 two independent verifiers · 6 real incidents become theorems
7 spec coherence before code conformance · 8 ship assumptions, rejected
alternatives and residuals · 9 silence never encodes a posture
10 a partial FCDD labelled beats a full FCDD pretended
11 operational constraints are deduced, not given
12 no unbounded loop in the method — every iterative beat
declares its budget before it starts

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHY BEAT 4 IS BOUNDED (case02, 56 runs)
under iterate-to-convergence the beat ran 1–18 rounds on repeats of the
SAME defect; round count correlated r = 0.72 with run cost and explained
~half its variance; runs with ≥6 rounds cost $48.33 vs $28.42 for ≤2 — and
all 56 runs produced a byte-identical artefact, so the extra rounds changed
nothing. The bounded control arm varied 3× and correlated −0.21.
Diagnosis measured; the fix's benefit is predicted, not yet demonstrated.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHAT FCDD DOES NOT ESTABLISH
proves COHERENCE, never correctness-of-intent — garbage clauses,
kernel-checked, are still garbage · the bridge cannot catch COMMON-MODE
error: one author writing spec AND twin makes both agree and every layer
pass, yielding maximal false confidence — only an independent reviewer
and reality can · it CAUGHT the hollow monitor, it did not PREVENT it
